sceneConcept: A short compact nineteen-year-old Chinese Sword Pavilion trainee stands alone against a transparent background. Short tousled black hair, brown eyes and a small friendly smile make him look like an ordinary student. He wears a faded blue striped track jacket open over a plain white t-shirt, dark track pants, scuffed sneakers and old white boxing wraps around both wrists. Both arms hang down casually, with his uncovered right hand held slightly away from the hip in one small nervous tremor. Soft even frontal studio light preserves the youthful grounded design. Visual refresh: a red hoodie under a short jacket with loose cargo trousers and worn sneakers.
